verdict.rationale: AssemblyAI documents an official first-party "Docs MCP server" that coding agents can connect to for mid-session documentation lookups, and a probe confirms it is documented on the coding-agent-prompts page. Its scope appears limited to documentation retrieval rather than exposing transcription or other API actions as agent tools, and the description is only a brief mention. missing for 10: an MCP server exposing actual product capabilities (transcription, streaming, speech analysis) as tools; setup and connection documentation; independent or hands-on corroboration.
